description: Multi-vendor CCTV recorder (DVR/NVR) forensic log extraction and analysis workbench
changes: Fixed a startup crash in compiled builds using bound Qt slots, pinned dependencies, a short-path build venv and native crash diagnostics.
Installer choice between per-user and all-users installation.
Physical Drive checks for Administrator rights and offers Restart as Administrator; a header badge shows when the app is elevated.
Result rows show a short explanation summary; the full text is in the record details window (double-click).
Tooltips stay readable with the Windows light theme.
New System theme (default) follows the Windows light/dark setting and switches live; Dark and Light remain available.
Licensed under GPL-3.0.
Cooperative extraction cancellation for TVT, Hikvision and Dahua, with explicit cancelled workspaces and incomplete-file handling.
Integrated Hikvision Security Audit, Camera/Motion and Log Statistics tabs with global-filtered SQL pagination and full record/hex inspection.
Expanded TVT SDK named types with action namespace provenance, and Dahua actor/source/configuration columns plus explanations for every JSON field.
Clean source-control exclusions and a source packaging script.
Case folder selection with unique per-image analysis workspaces, separate databases/reports, retained entropy results, manifest and UTC audit log.
Report-specific log-type selection exports only checked events (for example config) with a live record count, independently of column selection.
HTML report content selector: choose fields, record scope, title, logo, metadata and page size before saving. Excluded fields are omitted from the search index.
TVT original mlogtype column and independent global UI/HTML filter, with automatic backfill for older extraction databases.
CCTV Log Analyzer 1.01, the successor of HikvisionLogAnalyzer.
Scrollable full-text tab in the record details window.
Dahua source database filter applies to all rows and filtered exports.
Hikvision and TVT preserve raw record bytes with logical image offsets for the hex inspector.
Entropy survey supports every-byte whole-image scans or selected ranges, plain-language interpretations, paged candidates, byte progress, throughput, ETA and cancellation.
Modern PySide6 interface with dark and light themes and configurable fonts.
Recent evidence history stored privately in AppData and shown in the left sidebar.
Global search, date range filtering, per-column header filters and SQL pagination.
Real byte-based progress from TVT, Hikvision and Dahua engines using SSE event frames.
Detailed timestamped terminal output and non-blocking completion feedback.
Improved multi-signal DVR brand detection and tested TVT, Hikvision and Dahua engines.
Windows icon, version metadata and Inno Setup installer pipeline.
Compact evidence toolbar and collapsible sidebar provide more room for result rows.
Date calendars remain editable, auto-enable the filter and initialize from the dataset's actual date range.
Filtered CSV/HTML reports, blue report theme, embedded custom logo and double-click record inspector.
iCatch disks are identified from their hourly recording index; no usable logs were found on them, so no extraction is offered.
Dahua, Hikvision and TVT searches and HTML reports filter records by log category.
HTML reports add category counts, global in-report search, pagination and configurable title, page size, metadata and logo.
E01 small random reads use a bounded cache, while Hikvision and TVT sequential scans use larger blocks.
Dahua source database names omit host paths; result columns have usable widths and HTML reports export as linked, bounded pages.
A companion report index supports global text and category filtering across every exported HTML page.
The image picker remembers its last folder and extraction completion offers an Open Folder action.
